title: Music Genre Classifier
description:
Explored machine learning for music genre classification using MIDI data from the Lakh Dataset. Engineered features capturing tempo, instrumentation, rhythm, and melodic structure, and developed a preprocessing pipeline incorporating imputation, encoding, normalization, and resampling to address missing data and class imbalance.

Compared Linear and RBF SVMs, Decision Trees, and KNN using cross-validation and held-out testing. Achieved approximately 59% test accuracy with KNN, identifying class imbalance and generalization as key challenges.

title: Parkinson's Disease Typing Demonstration
description: Built an interactive website that visualizes how Parkinson's medication affects typing behavior using real-world keystroke data. Implemented D3.js visualizations and animations for medicated vs. unmedicated typing latency and accuracy.

title: LoL Regional Playstyle Analysis
description: Analyzed professional League of Legends match data from 2020–2024 to investigate regional differences in competitive play between Eastern (LCK/LPL) and Western (LEC/LCS) teams. Performed exploratory data analysis on champion selections, bans, and in-game performance metrics to identify potential differences in regional strategies. Developed and evaluated Logistic Regression and Random Forest classifiers to predict team region based on gameplay statistics, using GridSearchCV for hyperparameter optimization and class balancing to address regional data imbalance. Achieved 77.48% classification accuracy, demonstrating measurable differences in gameplay patterns across regions.

title: LLM Eval Systems Framework
description: A modular framework for evaluating large language model outputs using custom judge metrics, automated test suites, and comparative analysis across multiple model providers.
